status: Retrospective comparison; existing surrogate targets already inspected. Fixed before new model searches.
state_inheritance: Both retained and new branches inherit parent state, to isolate relaxation from resets. A common deterministic initial state makes the structured marginal reduction exact.
fitting_objective: Mean of condition-wise mean replicate total-variation distances; omit the held-out light condition. No pooling of replicates before scoring. Each daughter law is evaluated independently, with no law selection by held-out error.
numerical_checks: Frozen fitted parameters, dt/2, grid x2 and x4, domain expansion; exact material moments, positivity, support, no-event analytic growth and instantaneous limits.
